recipes.name: Tasty Baked Meatballs
ingredients_raw: 1 (10.5 ounce) can cream of mushroom soup
1 (1 ounce) package dry onion soup mix

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Line two baking sheets with aluminum foil and lightly grease.
Mix together ground beef, bread crumbs, cream of mushroom soup, eggs, Parmesan cheese, and onion soup mix. Shape beef mixture into 2-inch diameter balls; arrange on the prepared baking sheets.
Bake in the preheated oven until no longer pink in the center, about 30 minutes. An instant-read thermometer inserted into the center should read at least 160 degrees F (70 degrees C).

raw_recipe.headline: Tasty Baked Meatballs
raw_recipe.description: You can have meatballs ready in under an hour with ground beef, bread crumbs, eggs, cream of mushroom soup, Parmesan cheese, onion soup mix, and this recipe.

review.reviewBody: This is the best meatball recipe ever. I did not have onion soup mix. I used instead one packet of the Good Seasons Italian All Natural Salad Dressing & Recipe Mix instead. These meatballs melt in your mouth. I had also added two slices of torn white bread soaked in milk squeezing the milk out of the bread then adding it to the meat mix. The meat was very moist and sticky so I had bowl of warm water to dip my hands to make the meatballs. Every other meatball recipe I tried was dry and had no taste this is wonderful. Full marks A++++. Thanks for posting this recipe.

The ONLY thing I do is double the recipe but with 50/50 burger and ground pork like my momma and her momma always did, use a small, 1 oz food service scoop for consistency (flattened to the bowl) and place them on a standard slotted broiler tray (any grease drips into it and SUPER EASY cleanup) We get 49/tray and they cook in 24 minutes in my oven. The family, neighbors, and coworkers go nuts over these. Freeze em in a single layer, then super suck in meal serving quantities and they keep in the freezer for months (or literally until they finish them off.) Meatball sandwiches, spaghetti, mashed potatoes and gravy, plain........ they just don't last at my house and every few months the kids are begging for more.......

I followed this recipe with the exception of the onion soup mix. Per other reviews, I decided to use Italian dressing mix in place of onion soup mix. I also added 1 tsp garlic powder and 1/2 tsp onion powder. I put hamburger mixture in fridge to firm up. I think leaving them in the refrigerator for a few hours before forming into meatballs makes a big difference. I had no issues with the meat being too wet. It was very easy to work with.I cooked them as per the recipe and they came out amazing! Little meatballs full of flavor. They don’t come with a sauce and they don’t need them. I just served with chef John’s mashed potatoes and french style green beans. Everyone was happy. Thanks for a great recipe!

This recipe deserves 10 stars! Moist, tasty ... I will never use another recipe again. These turned out so well, even though I did make a few changes. Because of what I had on hand I used half ground chuck and half ground pork, added granulated garlic, minced onion, fresh parsley and about 1/2 c of milk. I didn't intend to use that much milk, just slipped when I poured it, and worried that I might have ruined it but not at all. I used an ice cream scoop to get uniform sized meatballs and they baked up in 20 minutes. I didn't turn them over and got flat meatballs that didn't bother me a bit but if you want yours round, flip them over half way through. Terrific recipe.

Made about 72 meatballs using my 1.5 T scoop. I used the Dry Onion Soup Mix recipe on this site. Extremely easy to mix together, scoop out onto a cookie sheet, and bake. Delicious by themselves with no sauce and taste like Swedish meatballs, probably because of the cream of mushroom soup. After cooking, I divided these into 5 batches and froze 4. Tonight, I served these with the gravy part from Turkey Swedish Meatballs. The left-overs will make an extremely easy dinner entree on a very busy night.
A very good recipe! However, I did omit the soup and added 3tbsp of Worchestershire sauce, 1tbsp of steak sauce, and 2tbsp of spicy brown mustard. Turned out great! Thank you!

Nobody makes meatballs like my mother in law, until this recipe. My wife and daughters love this. ‘My daughter now make this for their families.I’ve made this as written;with 1. Lb ground turkey 2 lbs ground beef,; substituting 1 kB ground sausage. No mater what I do it’s a hit. My only consistent modification is a can of golden cream of mushroom soup instead of the regular. Since I’m recently retired and have assumed the cooking duties this is definitely in my regular roatation. If I go to long without making it I’m reminded.

These meatballs are exceptional ! I use cream of chicken soup, add some ricotta cheese and cayenne pepper. We love spicy foods and the cayenne pepper really makes them stand out. I've used them for spaghetti, meatball sandwiches and just something to snack on. 
I've been making these for a LONG time. 
Thanks for the great recipe !

Awesome recipe! I wanted to try something different then the way I usually make my meatballs with spaghetti and saw this recipe, read the reviews and was grateful I had all the ingredients in stock. Well, except for Italian bread crumbs for I only had seasoned so I just added Italian seasonings. This was a hit with my family! My picky 9 yr old usually don't eat my meatballs but he ate these! I will be making these for now on! Thank you for sharing! ???

Amazing! We loved these - the only thing I did differently than the recipe was added minced onion and used about 1/2 pound sausage to finish up the entire amount of meat needed. Served over mashed potatoes and brown gravy, pan fried asparagus and hawaiian rolls. I used an ice cream scoop to help me keep the meatballs all about the same size. I cooked 16 and froze 16.
Family Really Enjoyed!!! The meatballs were very moist, and had a great flavor. I added onions, and bell peppers to my meatballs.

way too mushy to be meatballs. it just seemed like I was eating cat food. the texture was horrible and they just fell apart. I make meatballs quite a lot and they have never turned out like this. won't be making again

I've made this recipe tonight and the taste is really really good. I think next time I make these I try it without mixing the cream of mushroom in with everything else and just use the cream of mushroom as a sauce (wasn't meatball consistency that I'm used to..was more mushy). Otherwise great taste!
these are really good. i might add a bit more seasoning next time but not much really.
my go-to-recipe for meatballs! I don't change a thing!
Okay, just made and ate these and WOW are they delicious. My whole family loved them, including our pup! Didn't change a thing in the recipe. Great as is.
